title: Specific speed of centrifugal pump

symbols.definition: Speed of the pump in rpm
Head of the pump in m

applicability: Centrifugal pumps are generally classified as radial flow, mixed flow and axial flow based on specific speed. Radial-flow pumps have low specific speed, generally between 40 and 150. Mixed-flow specific speeds are 150 to 350. Above 350, flow is more or less parallel to the axis and these are called axial-flow pumps. For a double-suction pump, take only half the flow when calculating specific speed; the text states that this specific speed is only 70% of that for a single-suction design.
